rationale.complete: Round 1 done on the requested scope: card and dated predictions, Mathis A0 signatures, synthetic validation of sigma* and of the resolution test on real call schedules (with an expiry sweep that set E before real data), 6 replication periods and 2 natives (G44 arms, NE42) with verdicts, expiry/bin variants, the uncopying order q, estimates rows and a frozen, guarded confirm script (dry-run on stand-ins only).

Only the NE42 ordering and q contrast are positive, both weak or post hoc.
rationale.usefulness: Little to act on: the thermodynamic affinity from commit logs is a bookkeeping convention, and the practical lever (kickoff naming) was already H54's. The q < 1 (shared) vs q > 1 (private) departure-order contrast is a candidate monitor if it survives the holdout.
